skill.summary: Banana Republic is Gap Inc.'s upscale brand, evolving from travel-themed safari wear to refined business casual with a focus on high-end women's workwear.

latestVersion.changelog:
Banana Republic 1.0.0 – 初始版本发布

- 发布针对 Banana Republic 品牌历史、定位变迁及商业模式的完整概述
